steps.label: Continue Hulkenberg's training at Visca Alba Tavern (Follower rank 4).
Take the Spirited Youth's bungee challenge — a sure thing at Courage 2.
Depart for the Giant Sandworm's Nest; read 'Pride and Persuasion' (choice: gain the upper hand).
Stop by the Midnight Sunsands.
Another runner ambushes the route — Catherina rematch (Follower rank 2).
Campfire materials, then play a game with Hulkenberg.
A human blocks the road, then the Greatworm swallows the party.
Escape Giant Sandworm's Belly inside 15 minutes — run past common foes, loot everything, and fight only the rare Red Elmenta.
Corner the culprit in the underground channel — Heismay joins the party (Follower rank 1).
Martira prep: take 'The Man-Eater in the Mine', buy informant notes, and stock up at Cattleracket Road.
Return to Kriegante Castle and settle the castle trials.
Gallica reaches Follower rank 3 after the Martira operation.
Martira farewells: chat with the Cheerful Fairy and the Kind Old Woman, then talk with Bardon (Follower rank 1).
Hear the Elegant Performer's music and take 'The Queen of Cuisine: Heart'.
Debate Loveless at the King's Rock (answer: alcohol won't bring equality).
Set off for Man-Eater's Grotto; read 'Pride and Persuasion' (choice: scare them).
Komero stop: hand the ornament and journal to Neuras (Follower rank 1); take 'Relic Search: Inventor's Request', then buy the Practical Pidgeon Parcel plus the planned Magla Pills and Orgo Sugar.

guidanceSections.title: Komero stop
guidanceSections.body: Deliver the ornament and journal to Neuras, accept his relic request, and buy the Practical Pigeon Parcel here for Hatching a Plan.

steps.label: Turn in More's Task Chapter One: Ordeal (Follower rank 3).

guidanceSections.title: Requirement check
guidanceSections.body: Unlock Gunner before reporting More’s Chapter One. Studying the required Archetype is the task condition; the displayed route date is the planned turn-in.

steps.label: Turn in More's Task Chapter Two: Solitude with Merchant rank 15 already met (Follower rank 4); receive Chapter Three: Drifting.

guidanceSections.title: Requirement check
guidanceSections.body: Raise Merchant to rank 15 for this chapter. If it is still short, finish the training in a dungeon before reporting back to More.

steps.label: Clear Man-Eater's Grotto; recover Neuras' lost relic in the first zone and the Gold Beetle just north of the lower trance crystal.

guidanceSections.title: Relic route
guidanceSections.body: In the first area, use the crawl space to reach the relic chest marked on the map.

guidanceSections.title: Beetle check
guidanceSections.body: After the stairs and area transition, keep to the right. Search just north of the crystal before leaving the Grotto.

steps.label: Report the Practical Pidgeon Parcel to the Gloomy Youth to finish 'Hatching a Plan', then report the Man-Eater bounty at the Recruitment Centre.
Catch up with Maria (Follower rank 3).
Deliver the lost relic to Neuras (Follower rank 2); take 'Relic Search: Dregs of Destiny'.
Enter the Abandoned Tomb to recover Grius' dagger; Strohl consults you on deck (Follower rank 4).
Win the runner skirmish — swap Archetypes if anyone is weak to Wind or Ice.
Advise Hulkenberg at the campfire (Follower rank 5).
Runner upkeep, then finish 'Pride and Persuasion' (choice: plead with them).
Eloquence reaches rank 2 (Articulate).
Tomb depth run: grab the Gold Beetle by the ladder and fight through to the Trove.
Catch up with Maria (Follower rank 4).
Hand the ring to Cuculus; Alonzo makes his pitch (Follower rank 1).
Accompany Strohl to his old home (Follower rank 5); receive 'A Noble's Legacy'.
Debate Lina at the King's Rock (answer: what are your policies?).
Catch up with Maria (Follower rank 5).
Get to know Heismay (Follower rank 2).
Second Spirited Youth challenge — retry until the plunge lands.
Debate Roger at the King's Rock (answer: taxes benefit us all).

Warp to Grand Trad and clear the Mausoleum for the outstanding requests — take the left or right door first at three-door rooms, then hand the Mortaskulls to the Nervous Soldier to finish 'Skullduggery'.

guidanceSections.title: Mausoleum sweep
guidanceSections.body: Explore the side doors before committing to the central route. Gather the quest items during this visit, then report the Mortaskulls to the Nervous Soldier.

guidanceSections.title: If drops are missing
guidanceSections.body: Fight the relevant skeletons in squad battles rather than relying only on overworld defeats.

steps.label: Return the necklace to the Resentful Noble to finish 'A Haunted Heirloom', collect the Angry Man's potion, and help Heismay lay his son to rest (Follower rank 3).

guidanceSections.title: Capital return
guidanceSections.body: Give the necklace to the Resentful Noble on Sunlumeo Street. Revisit the Angry Man at the cathedral before the runner routine and Heismay visit.

steps.label: Give the King's Rock speech — match the answer to your crowd.
Eloquence reaches rank 3 (Urbane).
Sail for Port Brilehaven; cook Benevolent Bread for the Classy Woman (Maria's perk grants one free travel dish).
Finish 'New World Travel Diary' in the lounge, including its completion bonus.
At camp, spend time with Heismay (or another companion) for more Imagination.
Imagination reaches rank 3 (Visionary).
Cook Critical Meatballs from the worm meat drop.
Play Hulkenberg's game (balance offense and defense), then pass the City Ruins.
Start 'Bygone Days' at the campfire lounge.
Cook Invincible Noodles (or Redgrass Bidou), then continue 'Bygone Days'.
Catherina's runner attacks again — win the rematch (Follower rank 3).
Finish 'Bygone Days'.
Arrive in Brilehaven and collect all five route Gold Beetles: two on Seabreeze Street, two around Merchants' Bazaar, and one on Arenafront Wharf.

guidanceSections.title: Seabreeze Street
guidanceSections.body: Search the crates at the end of the Wary Shopkeep alley. For the other beetle, check east of the Calm Ferryman by the dock ramp before taking the ferry.

guidanceSections.title: Bazaar and wharf
guidanceSections.body: Check Black Cat’s Claw, the crates/carriage near the Recruitment Centre, and the open area north of the Arenafront Wharf stairs.

steps.label: Big Bargain Day shopping at Merchants' Bazaar; stock the planned Briny Salt, Fruit Cordial, Bluefin Tuna, and Mora Coney Meat.
At Arenafront Wharf, make the route's first Gold Beetle exchanges with the Elderly Entomophile for Arcane Dragonblood and Venomward Charm.

days.notes: July 21 is a story-only date with no route tasks. End day moves to the next authored date, July 22; this does not mark any July 22 task complete.

steps.label: Visit the Nightprowler.
Take the ferry to Charadrius — optional work can be handled through August 12; the main story resumes August 13.

guidanceSections.title: Mission window
guidanceSections.body: The operation window opens July 23 and ends August 12. The route chooses an earlier infiltration; the main story resumes August 13.

steps.label: Brilehaven request sweep: take 'Soldier's Solace', 'Deeds and Diversions', 'The Chalice vs. The Brew', 'Efflorescent Youth', 'Dental Distress', 'Superior Scrimshaw', and the 'Grieving Ghost of the Goblet' bounty; give the Man in Pain a Medicinal Herb for Briny Threads and a Tail Bait.

guidanceSections.title: Inn and Nightprowler
guidanceSections.body: Start with the Exhausted Woman at the Angler’s Inn. The Overfamiliar Man aboard the Nightprowler starts Deeds and Diversions.

guidanceSections.title: Wharf and Seabreeze
guidanceSections.body: Give the wharf’s Man in Pain a Medicinal Herb, then speak with the Brewer. On Seabreeze Street, visit the Kindly Boy and Sullen Man.

guidanceSections.title: Merchants’ Bazaar
guidanceSections.body: Speak with the Craftsman near Strohl, then collect the Grieving Ghost bounty at the Recruitment Centre. Acceptance and later completion are separate route actions.

steps.label: Get 'The Future of Magic' from Julian; this missable book remains obtainable through August 12.

guidanceSections.title: Missable book
guidanceSections.body: Speak with Julian at the Angler’s Inn before August 12 ends. Keep the book pickup separate from the later reading sessions aboard the runner.

steps.label: Warp to Grand Trad: buy the Rainbow Flower, collect the newly appeared Gold Beetle at the fourth market stall south of the Herb-Seller, and identify Strohl's inheritance merchant.

guidanceSections.title: Grand Trad
guidanceSections.body: Buy the Rainbow Flower at St. Fermis Church. Search the fourth market stall south of the Herb-Seller for the newly available beetle.

guidanceSections.title: Inheritance lead
guidanceSections.body: Speak with the fishmonger about Strohl’s father, then follow the lead to the Capital Merchant at the cathedral.

steps.label: Return to Brilehaven and give the Rainbow Flower to the Kindly Boy to finish 'Efflorescent Youth'.

guidanceSections.title: Return to the boy
guidanceSections.body: Bring the Rainbow Flower back to the Kindly Boy in Brilehaven before moving on to Martira. Buying the flower alone does not finish the request.

steps.label: Warp to Martira: collect the Gold Beetles in the MesmerEyes spice bag and by the Cattleracket Road hay bales, deliver Benevolent Bread to finish 'The Queen of Cuisine: Heart', then talk with Bardon (Follower rank 2).

guidanceSections.title: Martira pickups
guidanceSections.body: At MesmerEyes, inspect the red spice bag beside the stairs. On Cattleracket Road, search the hay bales near the separate cow.

guidanceSections.title: Finish the visit
guidanceSections.body: Deliver Benevolent Bread to the Classy Woman at Visca Alba, then meet Bardon. Keep this city stop after the Brilehaven flower delivery.

steps.label: Debate Jin at the King's Rock (answer: we should help anyone).
Debate Glodell at the King's Rock (answer: you only parrot Louis).
Accompany Heismay to his village (Follower rank 4).
With 15 Archetypes studied, turn in More's Task Chapter Three: Drifting (Follower rank 5); receive Chapter Four: Turmoil.

guidanceSections.title: More’s requirement
guidanceSections.body: Study 15 different Archetypes before reporting Chapter Three. A new chapter in the ledger records a task to do; it does not mean its requirement is already complete.

steps.label: Infiltrate Charadrius — complete Sergeant Xanth's key objective, then take either the Maintenance Chief Ceiba or Master Sergeant Glechom corridor branch; only one corridor branch is needed for Help Anyone in Need. Tetrabreak is the key item for the boss chain.

guidanceSections.title: Before entry
guidanceSections.body: Bring Tetrabreak for Ceiba’s physical barrier. Xanth can be controlled with ailments while you work on his key objective.

guidanceSections.title: Choose one corridor
guidanceSections.body: Ceiba and Glechom are alternative branches for the completion route. Tetrabreak opens Ceiba to physical damage; Glechom calls for handling his opening Daze and attacks.

guidanceSections.title: Later guards
guidanceSections.body: Cabio is weak to Electric and Salva to Pierce. Check party weaknesses before the chain of fights.

steps.label: Chat with Bardon (Follower rank 3).
Debate Rudolf at the King's Rock (answer: the tribes must stand together).
Forgiveness Day (30% off): prep dungeon supplies and buy the Archetypal Ring.
Tell Strohl about the inheritance merchant (Follower rank 6).
Tolerance reaches rank 3 (Generous).
Debate Milo at the King's Rock (answer: beauty is deeper than our skin).
Eloquence reaches rank 4 (Influential).
Bardon shows off his project (Follower rank 4).
Coliseum certification battle — down the Crag Manjula quickly via its Strike weakness for the 25,000 reeve prize.
Depart on the three-dungeon road trip toward the Tomb of Lament via Inundo; cook Coney Stew; lend Hulkenberg an ear (Follower rank 6).
Inundo stop: buy the Toothbrush of Hygienia for 'Dental Distress', plus the planned Mellow Milk and Briny equipment.
Campfire, then a heart-to-heart with Heismay (Follower rank 5).
Cook Curative Coney Roast, then read 'The Future of Magic'.
Stop by the Peregrine Falls.
Wisdom reaches rank 3 (Knowledgeable).
Tomb of Lament: two Gold Beetles and Neuras' lost relic — hug the left wall and mind the crawl spaces.

guidanceSections.title: Lost relic
guidanceSections.body: From the stairs beside the Battered Adventurer, use the nearby crawl-space route to the marked relic chest.

guidanceSections.title: Two beetles
guidanceSections.body: After the first wall-door mechanism, search the crawl space north of the lower-floor entry. Before the boss, inspect the crawl space east of its door beyond the mimic.
